principle: Spells are cast with the Spellcasting skill using Protocol Dice. Prepared workings load into Capacity. No Vancian slots.

casting_rules.resolution: Roll Spellcasting (or Ritual for marked ritual spells) vs Difficulty, or opposed defense when noted.
casting_rules.prepared: A spell must be prepared (loaded into Capacity) to cast in a scene, unless the spell says otherwise.
casting_rules.failure: Failed cast spends AP. The spell does not take effect. Optional backlash is a table choice for later playtest.

spells.name: Veil
spells.summary: Blur attention. Gain Advantage on your next Stealth check this scene, or impose Disadvantage on one watcher spotting you.
spells.detail: Modern: crowd camouflage. Archaic: a whisper of mist. Same roll.

spells.name: Hexbolt
spells.summary: Ranged occult attack. On success, damage equals winning margin (active defense).
spells.detail: Looks like lightning, cold fire, or a thrown rune — fiction only.

spells.name: Mending Touch
spells.summary: Heal an adjacent ally for Narrow/Solid/Powerful/Overwhelming → 3/5/8/12 HP (by margin band).
spells.detail: Cannot raise a corpse. Stabilizes fictionally on Narrow if the table wants mercy.

spells.name: Ward Circle
spells.summary: Scene-length circle. Allies inside add Feature d4 to Fortitude/Will vs intrusion you named when casting.
spells.detail: Ritual skill. Takes a short setup beat; not a snap fight cast.

spells.name: Compel Truth
spells.summary: Ask one narrow question. On success, the target answers truthfully or takes a Solid social/occult consequence the fiction supports.
spells.detail: Not mind control. Creatures bound by oath, hospitality, or true name sit at Moderate (12) instead if the GM agrees.

spells.name: Open the Way
spells.summary: Unstick a mundane lock, latch, or simple ward. Hard locks/wards are 16; magical seals 20+.
spells.detail: Does not erase alarms. Security skill may still matter afterward.

spells.name: Shadow Step
spells.summary: Instantly move up to 30 feet to a space you can see that is in dim light, cover, or threshold fiction.
spells.detail: Replaces a normal move. Line of effect required.

spells.name: Reveal
spells.summary: Add Advantage to your next Perception or Investigation roll this scene when hunting occult residue or concealment.
spells.detail: Stacks poorly with Second Sight Feature die — pick the better named source; do not invent flat bonuses.
